Search.hintBody: Start typing to find a screen, a project, a person or a department.

Common.errorBody: The page could not be loaded. It may be a temporary problem.

Placeholder.comingSoonBody: This screen arrives in a later milestone. The shell around it is real.

Auth.signUpSubtitle: You will be its owner. You can invite the rest of the team afterwards.
Auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match.
Auth.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Auth.emailTaken: An account already uses that email.
Auth.cannotRevokeCurrent: That is the device you are using now.
Auth.notAMember: You are not a member of that organization.
Auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Every other device has been signed out.
Auth.sessionsBody: Sign out any device you do not recognise. Your current one stays.
Auth.sessionRevoked: That device has been signed out.

Errors.unauthorizedBody: Your session ended, either because it expired or because it was signed out from another device.
Errors.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this
Errors.forbiddenBody: Your account is still signed in. Ask an administrator if you think you should be able to see this.

Today.title: Today
Today.queueBody: Work that has stopped, slipped, or has nobody on it.
Today.blockedBody: Stopped, and will not restart on its own.
Today.overdueBody: Past its date and still open.
Today.allClearBody: No blocked, overdue or unassigned work right now.
Today.nextTaskBody: The one thing to pick up if you only do one.
Today.nothingTodayBody: You have no late or due-today work. Enjoy it.
Today.noWork: No open work assigned to you
Today.noWorkBody: When someone assigns you a task it will appear here.

Work.title: Work
Work.noProjectsBody: A project groups the work, the people on it, and the date it has to meet.
Work.noMatchesBody: Try a different status or clear the search.
Work.openTasks: {count, plural, =0 {No open tasks} one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
Work.blockedCount: {count, plural, =0 {none blocked} one {# blocked} other {# blocked}}
Work.projectNotFoundBody: It may have been archived, or the link may be wrong.
Work.noTasksBody: Add the first deliverable and it will show up here.
Work.noTeamBody: Add people so the work can be assigned.
Work.noActivityBody: Changes to this project will be listed here.

Task.blockerReasonRequired: Say what is stopping it, so someone can unblock it.
Task.title: Title
Task.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}

People.title: People
People.name: Name
People.noPeopleBody: Invite the first person and they will appear in the directory.
People.noMatchesBody: Try a different role or clear the search.
People.personNotFoundBody: They may have left the organization, or the link may be wrong.
People.noProjectsBody: They will appear here once they are added to one.
People.noOpenWorkBody: Nothing is assigned to them right now.
People.noActivityBody: Their changes will be listed here.
People.inviteBody: They will appear in the directory straight away and can be assigned work. No email is sent yet.
People.alreadyMember: They are already in this organization.
People.onlyOwnerCanInviteOwner: Only an owner can add another owner.
People.onlyOwnerCanEditOwner: Only an owner can change an owner.
People.lastOwner: The last owner cannot be demoted.
People.notFound: That person is no longer here.

NewProject.title: New project
NewProject.name: Project name
NewProject.keyHint: Two to five letters. Used in the URL and the command palette.
NewProject.keyFormat: Two to five letters, A to Z.
NewProject.keyTaken: Another project already uses that key.
NewProject.assignmentBody: Their current workload is shown, so nobody is loaded up by accident.
NewProject.openTasks: {count, plural, =0 {free} one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
NewProject.deliverablesBody: One per line. Each becomes a task, and you can add more later.
NewProject.deliverablesPlaceholder:
Stakeholder interviews
Positioning territories
Logo refinement
NewProject.reviewBody: Check it over. Nothing is saved until you publish.

Inbox.title: Inbox
Inbox.subtitle: What happened that involves you.
Inbox.unread: {count, plural, =0 {All read} one {# unread} other {# unread}}
Inbox.emptyBody: When someone assigns you work, blocks a task on your project, or changes what you can do, it lands here.

Notification.leaveCancelled: cancelled time off you had approved

Channels.title: Channels
Channels.subtitle: Where the work gets talked about. Every project has one.
Channels.noneJoined: You have not joined a channel yet.
Channels.noneBody: A channel appears here as soon as a project has one. Open a project and choose Channel to start its conversation.
Channels.emptyBody: Everything that happens on this work will show up here. Start the conversation.
Channels.deleteBody: It stops being readable, and the space it held stays in the conversation so the thread still makes sense.
Channels.viewingNow: {count, plural, one {# other person here now} other {# other people here now}}
Channels.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
Channels.collapsedUpdates: {count, plural, one {# update on this work} other {# updates on this work}}

Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.subtitle: Meetings, deadlines and what is due, in the order it happens.
Calendar.emptyBody: No meetings, no deadlines, nothing due in this range. Widen it, or schedule something.
Calendar.emptyMineBody: Switch to Everyone to see what the rest of the organization has on.
Calendar.weekdayShort: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun

Meeting.notInvited: You are not on the invitation. You can still read it.
Meeting.cancelBody: Everyone expected is told, and it stays on the calendar struck through so nobody turns up.
Meeting.rescheduleBody: Everyone answers again, because a yes was a yes to a time.
Meeting.notesPlaceholder: What was agreed, and who is doing what.
Meeting.newSubtitle: Pick a time, then see who is free before you invite them.
Meeting.agendaPlaceholder: What needs deciding, so people arrive ready.
Meeting.conflictWarning: {count, plural, one {# person is already booked} other {# people are already booked}}
Meeting.invalidWindow: A meeting needs to end after it starts, and run no longer than 12 hours.
Meeting.noneUpcoming: Nothing in your diary this week.

Leave.title: Time off
Leave.subtitle: What you have asked for, and what is left.
Leave.requestBody: Weekends do not count. Public holidays are not tracked yet.
Leave.halfDayHint: Available when you ask for a single day.
Leave.costs: {days, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
Leave.costsNothing: That range is all weekend, so it costs nothing and asks for nothing.
Leave.cancelBody: It comes off the team calendar and the days go back into your balance. The record of having asked stays.
Leave.noneMine: You have not asked for any time off.
Leave.noneMineBody: When you do, it shows here and on the calendar once it is approved.
Leave.waitingBody: Nobody has asked for time off.
Leave.declineBody: Say why. A no with no reason is one people ask about twice.
Leave.overlap: You already have time off across those days.
Leave.noWorkingDays: That range is all weekend. Pick days you would otherwise be working.
Leave.range: The end has to be on or after the start.
Leave.alreadyDecided: Somebody has already answered that one.

Insights.title: Insights
Insights.subtitle: What has gone wrong, and whether the work is keeping up.
Insights.atRiskBody: Projects with work blocked, work late, or a deadline already past.
Insights.nothingAtRiskBody: No project has blocked work, overdue tasks or a deadline behind it. This is the empty state you want.
Insights.openTasks: {count, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
Insights.stuckBody: Ordered by how long, not by how important. The thing blocked for three weeks is the one nobody is looking at any more.
Insights.nothingStuckBody: No task is waiting on anybody.
Insights.throughputBody: Tasks created against tasks completed, by week. More created than completed means the queue is growing.
Insights.throughputCaption: Tasks created and completed, by week, for the last twelve weeks.
Insights.loadBody: Open work, late work, and the two things that quietly eat a week: hours already committed to meetings, and days somebody will not be here.

Crm.title: Pipeline
Crm.subtitle: What is being sold, and how far along it is.
Crm.companiesSubtitle: Everyone you work with, and everyone you might.
Crm.contactsSubtitle: The people you actually talk to.
Crm.openDeals: {count, plural, one {# open deal} other {# open deals}}
Crm.stageValue: {value} in {count, plural, one {# deal} other {# deals}}
Crm.noDealsBody: Open one and it appears here, and on the board.
Crm.noDealsMatchBody: Widen the search, or include closed deals.
Crm.noCompaniesBody: Add the first one; contacts and deals hang off it.
Crm.noContactsBody: Add somebody, with or without a company attached.
Crm.lostBody: A pipeline with no reasons on the lost deals teaches nobody anything once the quarter is over.
Crm.lostReasonPlaceholder: Price, timing, went to an incumbent…
Crm.money: That does not look like an amount. Digits, and at most two decimals.
Crm.alreadyThere: It is already at that stage.
